scope: Eight scalar and finite-list lemmas establish midpoint separation, interval gates, prefix/suffix filter bounds, strict count separation and invariance under permutation. Connecting the true source ranks and certified roots to these hypotheses remains a written/computational argument; the arithmetic and full matching theory are not formalized here.
